subject: RETURN statement
notes: kb/Work PB337, LANDED. The RETURN twin of SR-14.9.30.3-1, and the SAME screen: SortBinder.BindReturn reaches it through MoveBinder.BindIntoPhrase with IntoPhraseRules.Return, so the two verbs cannot drift. The wording difference is carried on the rules row rather than in a second code path -- RETURN's arm a) reads 'If only one record description is subordinate to the sort-merge file description entry', with no record-less admission, because 13.4.6.3 SR2 requires a record description under an SD (and the binder already rejects one that has none), where 13.4.5.3 SR3 permits a record-less FD. Arm b) is the identical operand set, so it is the identical ItemCategory.IsAlphanumericOrNational call over identifier-1 and every SD record. Diagnostic COBOL1994. PRE-FIX MEASUREMENT: an SD with '01 S-REC' (an alphanumeric group) and '01 S-NUM PIC 9(6)' (elementary, category numeric) returned INTO an alphanumeric group compiled AND RAN on this worktree's own build, printing INTO=1ONE / INTO=2TWO; it now draws COBOL1994 at all four editions. The positive golden's case R is the RETURN over-reject guard -- an SD with TWO alphanumeric-group records into an alphanumeric group is ADMITTED by arm b) and returns its record unchanged.
